name: Trend Reversal
market_conditions: price in an extended trend showing signs of exhaustion
price at a major key level such as a multi-year high/low, major Fibonacci level, or round number
volume climax or capitulation event present
at least 3 confluence factors pointing to reversal
higher timeframe trend has been running for an extended period
phase_requirements: late-stage markup phase transitioning to distribution for bearish reversal
late-stage markdown phase transitioning to accumulation for bullish reversal
entry_conditions: price reaches a major key level after extended trend move
oscillator divergence: RSI or MACD making lower highs while price makes higher highs (bearish), or higher lows while price makes lower lows (bullish)
reversal candlestick pattern: engulfing, evening star, morning star, or head and shoulders completion
volume climax on the final push with subsequent volume dry-up
minimum 3 confluence factors present simultaneously before entry
confirmation_requirements: RSI divergence confirmed on at least two timeframes
MACD histogram divergence or bearish/bullish cross at the key level
volume climax followed by at least 2-3 candles of declining volume
reversal candlestick pattern completed with a close in reversal direction
break of short-term trend structure: a prior swing low broken for bearish reversal, or swing high broken for bullish
at least 3 independent confluence factors: divergence counts as 1, volume climax as 1, key level as 1, pattern as 1
stop_loss_logic: Place stop beyond the extreme of the reversal point — above the high for bearish reversals, below the low for bullish reversals. Use ATR-based buffer (1-1.5 ATR beyond the extreme) to avoid stop-hunting. Stops on reversal trades should be wider than average given the uncertainty.
take_profit_logic: Target the most recent prior swing point in the opposite direction. For bearish reversal: target the most recent swing low or Fibonacci retracement levels (0.382, 0.5, 0.618) of the prior trend. Take scaled profits at each level. Hold a portion for larger target at 50% Fibonacci retracement of the entire trend.
invalidation_conditions: price makes a new high (for bearish reversal) or new low (for bullish reversal) after entry
divergence resolves to the upside without price reversing
volume does not dry up after the climax candle, indicating continuation
price breaks back above the key resistance for bearish reversal without hesitation
fewer than 3 confluence factors present — single signals are insufficient
broader market trend accelerating in original direction

required_features.trend_duration: extended move prior to reversal signal

timeframe_requirements.macro: 1W or 1D to assess trend maturity and identify major key levels
timeframe_requirements.entry: 4H or 1H for divergence confirmation and entry candle pattern

risk_notes: Reversal trades are low-probability setups that carry the highest risk of trading against momentum. Never attempt a reversal trade with fewer than 3 confluence factors. Even with strong confluence, only risk 0.5-1% per trade. Reversal entries require patience — wait for the complete confluence stack before entering. Partial position sizing is recommended with the ability to add on confirmation. Many reversal attempts fail before the actual reversal occurs.
typical_rr: 1:3 to 1:6 on successful reversals due to catching the beginning of a new trend

agent_rules.rule: Enforce a hard minimum of 3 confluence factors before any reversal entry — never enter on 1 or 2 signals alone.
RSI or MACD divergence must be visible on the primary entry timeframe — do not fabricate divergence from minor swings.
Reduce position size to 50% of standard risk on reversal trades — they have higher failure rates.
If price makes a new extreme after entry (new high for short reversal), exit immediately — do not average down.
Wait for the short-term trend structure to break (a swing point violated) before committing full size.
Volume climax must be followed by at least two candles of declining volume — a single volume spike without follow-through is insufficient.
